items.title_en: Sickening meal 'Eunuch Maker' who inspired surgeon to remove his own legs would cook on livestream
items.title_zh: 令人作呕的“太监制造者”激励外科医生切除自己的双腿将在直播中烹饪
items.summary_en: A man who inspired an NHS surgeon's sickening plot to get his own legs amputated broadcasted a host of horrifying content to paying customers. Known as the 'Eunuch Maker', Marius Gustavson made a lot of money from mutilating willing participants and livestreaming these extreme body modifications. The 48-year-old was described as 'a butcher' and 'an arch-manipulator' when he was jailed for life in 2024 at the Old Bailey - and the court heard all of the sordid details of his 'lucrative' online enterprise . items.summary_zh: 一名男子怂恿英国国民医疗服务体系（NHS）的外科医生实施截肢的令人作呕的计划，他向付费客户播放了一系列恐怖内容。马吕斯·古斯塔夫森被称为“太监制造者”，他通过肢解自愿参与者和直播这些极端的身体改造赚了很多钱。 2024 年，这位 48 岁的男子在老贝利被判终身监禁，当时他被描述为“屠夫”和“主要操纵者”——法庭听取了他的“屠夫”的所有肮脏细节。
